instructions: The marks are indicated in the right-hand margin.
There are NINE questions in this paper.

sections.section_title:
Q.1 Choose the correct answer of the following (Any seven question
                    only):

questions.text: The team of researchers, along with their supervisor, _____ scheduled to announce the results tomorrow for the conference.
Neither the students nor the teacher _____ aware of the sudden change in the timetable.
If anyone calls, tell _____ that I will return their call in the afternoon.
Neither Raj nor his brothers brought _____ ID cards to the examination hall.
Which of the following sentences contains a redundancy?
options: He made a final conclusion after the meeting.
They took a short break before the next session.
The CEO delivered a concise presentation.

questions.text: Identify the redundant expression in the sentence: "We should all gather together at 6 PM for the farewell party."
Choose the sentence that is free of redundancy:
options: The ATM machine is out of service.
He made a brief summary of the report.
We should plan for the trip.
They collaborated jointly on the assignment.

questions.text: By the time the movie started, we _____ for more than half an hour.
If she _____ earlier, she wouldn't have missed the train.
They _____ the new system by the end of this month.

You are Rohan Mehta, a final-year B. Tech student in Computer Science at Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Technology, Bengaluru. Your college recently conducted an industrial visit to Infosys Campus in Mysuru. The visit included seminars on cloud computing, AI demonstrations, and interaction with senior software engineers. You found the experience extremely enriching and believe it will benefit future batches as well. You wish to formally express your appreciation for the hospitality and knowledge shared during the visit. Additionally, you would like to request that Infosys consider offering internship opportunities to students from your college.

Write a formal letter to the HR Manager, Infosys, Mysuru Campus. Your letter should: 1. Express gratitude for the industrial visit and hospitality, 2. Mention specific highlights of the visit, 3. Suggest potential collaboration in the form of internships for students.

You are Priya Nair, a final-year B. Tech student in Electronics and Communication Engineering at Sardar Patel Institute of Technology, Mumbai. You are currently preparing to apply for a summer internship at a Bengaluru-based AI startup, Mind Byte Technologies.

Over the past year, you have actively upskilled yourself. You completed an "Artificial Intelligence Foundations" course on Coursera, and earned certifications in both Java and Python programming through NPTEL. You also developed a mini-project titled "Smart Traffic Light System Using AI" as part of your final year coursework. You are now required to draft a one-page résumé to apply for this internship, highlighting your technical skills, certifications, academic background, and relevant project work.
Write an essay in 200 words on "Importance of Time for Engineering Students".
Write an essay in 200 words on "Renewable Energy: The Future of Sustainable Development".

You are Amit Sharma, a Junior IT Officer working for the Municipal Corporation of Jaipur. Your department recently implemented a new digital system to manage public complaints regarding waste management services. The system allows residents to file complaints online, track the status of their complaints, and receive updates on resolution.

After the first month of implementation, you have been asked by your department head to prepare a progress report on the system's performance. The report should highlight the number of complaints received, the resolution rate, any technical issues encountered, and suggestions for improvements.
What are the 7 C's of professional writing? Explain in detail.
How does Bacon categorize the purposes of studying, and what practical advice does he give about the appropriate use of books in "Of Studies"?
Discuss Bacon's view on the relationship between studies and human character. How does he believe studies can help correct personal defects?
In what ways does Donne personify the sun, and how does this enhance the central theme of love in the poem "The Sun Rising"?
How does O. Henry develop the theme of hope and sacrifice through the character of Behrman in "The Last Leaf"?

Email writing etiquettes.
Difference between Coherence & Cohesion with appropriate examples.
